Tragedy strikes RIMS hospital in Adilabad

A tragedy occurred at the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) hospital in Adilabad, where smoke caused distress. Reports said poor management of the electrical system and air‑conditioners was blamed for the incident.
